'''Kombat''' is a one-day duel tournament played '''Sunday, July 17''', 21:00 {{Abbr/CEST}}.
The ambition is to bring more quick and easy tournaments into Quakeworld during the summer that doesn't require scheduling for each and every match.

Streamed by {{player|andeh|flag=se}} at [http://www.twitch.tv/suddendeathtv SuddenDeathTV]
== Format ==
* Single Elimination Bracket
* Sunday July 17
* DM2 DM4 DM6 ZTNDM3 AEROWALK
* All matches are {{Abbr|BO3|Best of 3}}

== Rules ==
* Map order: cmd rnd for first pick. then p2 pick. p1 toss, p2 toss, remaining map as decider.
* European tournament (other regions are welcome but EU servers are prioritized for lowest ping)
* Client: ezQuake
* Same map can not be played twice.
* Ruleset: smackdown/qcon
* Walkovers given if opponent fail to show 20 min after tournament start.
* Reporting: send screenshots in [http://discord.quake.world/ discord] channel: <mark>#kombat</mark>, or message {{Player|Alice|flag=se}}
